Constants, type declarations, and base58 address formatting helpers for Flamenco.

# Purpose
`fd_flamenco_base.h` is a common header for the Flamenco code base. It defines default cluster and epoch constants, null marker values, and helper macros for Base58 encoding of 32-byte and 64-byte data with stack allocation support. The file also declares shared types used across the runtime, such as bank, transaction, account, feature, and program cache structures, plus the `fd_account_meta` and `fd_rawtxn_b` data records. It also provides the inline helper [`fd_acct_addr_cstr`](<#fd_acct_addr_cstr>) to convert a 32-byte Solana address into a Base58 C string.
